build_roberta_model: build a RoBERTa model instance using RobertaModel.build_model with args and task
register_classification_head: register a new classification head on a RoBERTa model with num_classes and inner_dim
extract_features: extract token-level features from input tokens using RobertaEncoder.extract_features
load_pretrained_roberta: load a pretrained RoBERTa model using RobertaModel.from_pretrained with model name or path
configure_roberta_architecture: configure a RoBERTa base or large architecture using base_architecture or roberta_large_architecture
